entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 82:1-8 . Before the great Judge, the judges of the earth are rebuked, exhorted, and threatened.

entries.heading: 2. accept the persons
entries.text: 2. accept the persons --literally, "lift up the faces," that is, from dejection, or admit to favor and communion, regardless of merit ( Le 19:15; Pr 18:5 ).
3, 4. So must good judges act ( Ps 10:14; Job 29:12 ).
5. By the wilful ignorance and negligence of judges, anarchy ensues ( Ps 11:3; 75:3 ). out of course --(Compare Margin; Ps 9:6; 62:2 ).
6, 7. Though God admitted their official dignity ( Joh 10:34 ), He reminds them of their mortality.

entries.heading: 7. fall like,
entries.text: 7. fall like, &c.--be cut off suddenly ( Ps 20:8; 91:7 ).
8. As rightful sovereign of earth, God is invoked personally to correct the evils of His representatives.
